title: Global problems
descriptionFa: بلایای طبیعی، مشکلات اجتماعی، آلودگی و ترافیک.

words.example: A flood is a natural disaster.
The earthquake woke everyone up at four in the morning.
After the heavy rain, there was a flood in the village.
words.tipFa: oo اینجا «آ» خونده می‌شه. فعلش: The river floods every spring.

words.example: The snowstorm closed the roads to the mountains.
Firefighters worked all night to stop the forest fire.
The metro is very crowded in the morning.
This charity helps poor families in the city.
words.tipFa: ضدش: rich. poor معنی «بیچاره» هم می‌ده: Poor you!

words.example: Some homeless people sleep in the park in summer.
My cousin has been unemployed since the factory closed.
Air pollution is a big problem in Tehran in winter.
The river is so polluted that the fish are dying.
Millions of people left their homes because of the war.
The bus drivers are on strike today, so I'm walking to work.
Nobody was hurt in the car crash, but both cars were damaged.
We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours.
Avoid the motorway during the rush hour.
